entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ge-tindego ko Tulus si be-em me'y le-menimbag ge begen inok ge-tuwa ku be-em brab ge-datu-o ko be-em. Ge-safa-a ku bene'y enda e ke-ataga ku brab ati'y barakat Mu-we, e ke-meskina ku-we brab keungangen mu-we.
Enda e se-giyo Tulus we-e Be-em sa-en, e Temabang ngo enok u-wen ni kamarasayan, e Turun.
